name: calf_stretch_office

person.base: a young Japanese woman in her late 20s
person.outfit: white blouse, beige tweed jacket and beige wide-leg trousers
person.hair: dark hair tied back in a low ponytail
person.audience: Japanese office workers in their 20s to 40s who sit at a desk all day

space_desc: a modern open office with light wood desks, white office chairs, monitors, large windows with soft daylight, potted plants, a few colleagues blurred working in the background.
action_desc: she sits on the chair and does a gentle seated calf and hamstring stretch, extending one leg forward with the heel on the floor and toes up, leaning forward and reaching her hands toward the shin, then switching legs. Calm, relaxed breathing, slight natural smile, moves slowly like an office worker taking a short break.
audio: Ambient office sound only, quiet keyboard typing and air conditioning, no music, no speech.
